parameters.title: The section's heading.
parameters.rows: The rows (Fluent2ListItems), all of one kind.
parameters.aside: A count or a note after the title.
parameters.selector: What picks the set of rows shown (tabs), under the head.
parameters.footer: A quiet line under the rows.
parameters.asCard: Whether the rows stand on a card.
parameters.dividers: Whether a hairline stands between rows.
